name: Dolls Front -Ningyou-tachi no Senjou-
source:
Twelve countries are fighting with their robotized armies in this world. Hero defeats the queen of one such country and gets a powerful black armor machine and the girl who serves as a key to using that machine. Main character will need to use all his wits and skills to conquer the world.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/12/vn-of-month-march-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
在这个世界上，十二个国家正以机器人化的军队交战。主人公击败了其中一国的女王，获得了一台强大的黑色装甲机甲，以及作为启动该机甲钥匙的少女。主人公将需要运用所有的智慧和技能来征服世界。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/12/vn-of-month-march-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
